resources.string: Swipe down quickly through a clip to cut it there.
Drag a clip up out of the timeline (or flick it up) to delete it.
Drag any clip\'s edge to trim it – a loupe shows where you are.
Scrub on the ruler or the picture and slide your finger down for ½, ¼, ⅛ speed.
Tap with two fingers to undo, three fingers to redo.
Double-tap the picture for full screen. Hold a finger on it and tap beside it to step frames.
In Text mode you can edit by text: delete words and the video is cut along.
